meta.title: When to Visit
meta.description: When each Wildora trip runs, month by month, and why: seasons, park closures and the best months for wildlife in the Western Ghats and beyond.

hero.title: The right trip for the month you can travel
hero.lede: Each of our trips runs only in the months that suit its wildlife, its weather and the parks' rules. Here is when each one departs, and why.

cta.title: Not sure which month suits you?
cta.lede: Send us your dates and the wildlife you hope to see. We will tell you which trip fits, or whether a private trip would suit better.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hello Wildora, could you help me choose the right month for a trip?

legend.label: Key
legend.on: The trip runs: fixed departures that month
legend.off: No departures: off season, monsoon or park closure
